environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on Ubuntu 22.04 with PHP 8.2 and php-intl. However, the php-fpm worker pool operates under a custom AppArmor profile (usr.sbin.php-fpm8.2-docapp) loaded in enforce mode. The profile specifies: owner /var/www/app/storage/documents/** r, owner /var/www/app/storage/documents/ r, /var/www/app/storage/logs/** w, /tmp/** rw, and deny /** rwlx as the final catch-all. The profile uses 'file' capability restrictions and explicitly does NOT include any 'include <abstractions/base>' or 'include <abstractions/nameservice>' directives that would grant broader filesystem reads. The profile was generated via aa-genprof during normal application operation and then manually hardened by removing glob patterns. Note: the profile allows reading within the documents directory subtree only, so path traversal attempts that resolve outside /var/www/app/storage/documents/ are denied at the kernel level regardless of POSIX DAC permissions.

config.profile_notes: No abstractions included; generated via aa-genprof then hardened
